DrivingReview.title: Learn from your last drive.
DrivingReview.intro: Review a short dashcam clip with your connected AI. See what went well, find something to practice, and take the report with you.
DrivingReview.free: Free CapCar tool. A free account and your own Gemini, OpenAI or Claude API connection are required. Provider usage charges may apply; a chat subscription does not necessarily include API access.
DrivingReview.chooseCar: Choose a car to review a drive
DrivingReview.uploadHelp: MP4, MOV or WebM · 1–60 seconds · up to 150 MB. Browser codec support varies. Trim longer footage on your device first.
DrivingReview.local: The full video stays on this device. CapCar prepares up to 12 still frames. Your connected AI receives the frames you include, coaching topics and any supporting details you add. Audio and file metadata stay on this device.
DrivingReview.privacy: Frames may show faces, plates or locations. Remove private frames or edit your clip before continuing. Frames are not automatically anonymized. Your provider’s data policies apply.
DrivingReview.frameHelp: Keep at least two frames. These are sparse snapshots, not continuous video: events between frames may be missed.
DrivingReview.focus: What would you like to reflect on?
DrivingReview.connectionHelp: Connect before choosing a clip. Leaving this page clears the footage; saved reviews remain in your garage.
DrivingReview.consent: I have permission to share these images. I agree to send the selected frames, coaching topics and any supporting details to my connected AI for this review.
DrivingReview.reviewing: Your AI is reviewing the frames…
DrivingReview.parked: For learning after a drive. Use while parked. For a professional assessment, work with a qualified driving instructor.
DrivingReview.suggestion: What to try on a future drive
DrivingReview.fixedLimit: This review uses selected stills. They cannot measure speed, braking or following distance, and may miss events between frames. One clip offers limited context about driving habits.
DrivingReview.saved: Saved under Saved reflections for this car
DrivingReview.learningHelp: Off by default. When enabled, only topics you explicitly approve are used to prioritize future reviews for this car. No automatic driver profile or safety score.
DrivingReview.resetHelp: Clear remembered topics and turn learning off? Saved reflections will remain.
DrivingReview.historyHelp: Your latest 20 saved reviews per car, including any supporting details, sync with your private garage. Garage history stores text and timestamps only.
DrivingReview.empty: Your first saved reflection will appear here.
DrivingReview.deleteHelp: Delete this reflection from your garage? This does not delete any copies retained by your AI provider.
DrivingReview.saveError: Could not save. Your reflection is still on this page. Check device storage and try again.

errors.file: Choose a supported video up to 150 MB.
errors.duration: Choose a clip between 1 and 60 seconds.
errors.decode: This browser could not read the clip. Try an MP4 with H.264 video.
errors.account: Sign in again before requesting a review.
errors.quota: Your provider’s quota or request limit was reached. Check your account and try later.
errors.provider: Your provider could not review these images. Check your connection and model access.
errors.invalid_result: The AI response could not be validated. No review was saved. Try again.
errors.unavailable: Could not generate a review. If the clip is still selected, you can retry from this page.
errors.invalid: The selected frames could not be submitted. Choose the clip again.

DrivingReview.previewTitle: A short clip. A clearer next step.
DrivingReview.previewBody: See what appears to go well, which situations are worth practicing, and the frames behind each suggestion. Download the report as an image or save it to your private garage.

details.title: Supporting details (optional)
details.help: Add road conditions or mark up to four moments using seconds from the start of the clip. Leave out names, plates and addresses.
details.conditionsExample: For example, wet road or limited visibility
details.invalidTime: Enter a time in seconds within the clip. You can use a decimal point or comma.
details.invalidSpeed: Enter a speed between 0 and {max} in the selected unit.

report.noStrength: The selected frames give too little evidence to identify a specific strength.
report.noImprovement: The selected frames give too little evidence for a specific practice point.
report.userDetailsHelp: These details are unverified. Timestamped entries may fall between sampled frames.
report.exportError: The report image could not be downloaded. Try again.
report.publicHelp: See strengths, practice points and limitations with video timestamps. Download your report as an image.
